```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="desk_1560x780x770">
  <!-- Dimensions (metres) -->
  <!-- Width (X): 1.56  -->
  <!-- Depth (Y): 0.78 (front faces -Y) -->
  <!-- Height (Z): 0.77 -->
  <link name="world"/>

  <!-- Desk parameters -->
  <!-- Leg geometry -->
  <!-- Four legs: 0.06 x 0.06 footprint, height 0.77 -->
  <!-- Drawer geometry -->
  <!-- Top thickness: 0.04 -->
  <!-- Drawer cavity height: 0.18, slide travel: 0.10 -->
  <!-- Drawer front depth aligns at front edge -->
  <!-- Coordinates: origin at floor center (X=0 mid width, Y=0 mid depth, Z=0 floor) -->

  <link name="desk_top">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.02" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- box 1.56 x 0.78 x 0.04 -->
      <!-- mass ~ 18 kg -->
      <mass value="18.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5*18.0*(0.78*0.78 + 0.04*0.04)/12" iyy="0.5*18.0*(1.56*1.56 + 0.04*0.04)/12" izz="0.5*18.0*(1.56*1.56 + 0.78*0.78)/12"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.02" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.56 0.78 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_top">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.35 0.20 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.02" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.56 0.78 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Drawer assembly -->
  <!-- Drawer rails/floor can be implicit via link; keep drawer as moving link only -->
  <link name="drawer">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Drawer runs between underside and bottom; centered in X, centered in Y at front-facing cavity region -->
      <!-- Drawer body dimensions: width 1.38, depth 0.62, height 0.18 -->
      <!-- Place drawer box at Z = top underside (0.04) + 0.18/2 + 0.01 gap = 0.04+0.09+0.01=0.14 -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="7.5"/>
      <!-- box 1.38 x 0.62 x 0.18 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.5*7.5*(0.62*0.62 + 0.18*0.18)/12" iyy="0.5*7.5*(1.38*1.38 + 0.18*0.18)/12" izz="0.5*7.5*(1.38*1.38 + 0.62*0.62)/12"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.38 0.62 0.18"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_drawer">
        <color rgba="0.50 0.33 0.18 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.38 0.62 0.18"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <!-- Leg links: each 0.06 x 0.06 x 0.77; inertia per box -->
  <link name="leg_fl">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" iyy="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" izz="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.06*0.06)/12"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.28 0.15 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_fr">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" iyy="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" izz="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.06*0.06)/12"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.28 0.15 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_bl">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" iyy="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" izz="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.06*0.06)/12"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.28 0.15 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_br">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" iyy="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.77*0.77)/12" izz="0.5*4.5*(0.06*0.06 + 0.06*0.06)/12"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.28 0.15 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Base (fixed frame) -->
  <link name="base_link"/>

  <!-- Place legs and top relative to base_link at origin -->
  <!-- Leg positions -->
  <!-- X: +- (width/2 - leg/2) = +- (0.78 - 0.03) = +-0.75 -->
  <!-- Y: +- (depth/2 - leg/2) = +- (0.39 - 0.03) = +-0.36 -->
  <!-- Front faces -Y: thus "front" is negative Y. -->
  <joint name="joint_leg_fl" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_fl"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.75 -0.36 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_fr" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_fr"/>
    <origin xyz="0.75 -0.36 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_bl" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_bl"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.75 0.36 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_leg_br" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="leg_br"/>
    <origin xyz="0.75 0.36 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Top fixed to base at Z = height - thickness/2 = 0.77 - 0.02 = 0.75 -->
  <joint name="joint_top" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="desk_top"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.75" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Drawer rail / drawer kinematics: sliding toward the front (-Y) -->
  <!-- Set drawer joint as prismatic along Y with axis (0 -1 0) so positive joint value moves toward front (-Y) -->
  <!-- Drawer resting position centered at Y = 0 (middle of desk depth) shifted slightly back to allow movement -->
  <!-- Drawer body depth 0.62. Front clearance: front edge of drawer at Y = -(0.39) when fully out.
       Drawer center at fully-out: centerY = frontEdge + depth/2 = (-0.39 + 0.31) = -0.08.
       Drawer center at fully-in: centerY = centerY_out + 0.10 = -0.08 + 0.10 = 0.02.
  -->
  <!-- Drawer joint origin at rest position: joint prismatic value q=0 corresponds to centerY=0.02 -->
  <joint name="joint_drawer_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <!-- Place drawer at rest: X=0, Y=0.02, Z=0.14 -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.10" effort="200" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="5.0" friction="2.0"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
